The India A vs New Zealand A 1st unofficial Test match is scheduled to start at 3:30 a.m. IST on Friday, October 24. Where will the India A vs New Zealand A 1st unofficial match be played? The India A vs New Zealand A 1st unofficial Test match will be played at the Bert Sutcliffe Oval, Lincoln, New Zealand. Where to watch the India A vs New Zealand A 1st unofficial Test match? The match will be telecast on the Sony Sports Network. It will also be livestreamed on the SonyLiv app and website.
